column1: # Protocol Buffers counters (.proto of proto2, proto3 and editions), for a rule with the prompt
# file-body-contract: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks line and
# block comments and string literals, leftmost region first, so a "message" in a comment or an option
# value does not count; a block comment that is never closed runs to the end of the file.
# "fields (approx)" counts a field declared at the start of a line with its number (optional, required
# or repeated, a scalar, message or map type), not an enum value; "streaming rpcs" an rpc whose
# request or response is a stream. ContractFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
